summary: A private install no longer stops when it cannot reach a central DNS zone.

fixes.title: Private install carries on without DNS rights
fixes.text: If a private install may not read or link a central DNS zone, it warns, names the task for your network team and carries on.

fixes.title: A failed build pool is replaced
fixes.text: A build pool left failed by an earlier run is removed and made again.

fixes.title: Installer advises only safe changes
fixes.text: Installer messages now suggest only safe changes.
